mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(gb_ai_daily_revenue_dine_in_revenue, 0)), 0) AS totalDineIn, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(gb_ai_daily_revenue_takeout_revenue, 0)), 0) AS totalTakeout, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(gb_ai_daily_revenue_platform_fee, 0)), 0) AS totalPlatformFee, COUNT(*) AS revenueRowCount, COUNT(DISTINCT gb_ai_daily_revenue_record_date) AS distinctRecordDates, MIN(gb_ai_daily_revenue_record_date) AS minRecordDate, MAX(gb_ai_daily_revenue_record_date) AS maxRecordDate FROM gb_ai_daily_revenue WHERE gb_ai_daily_revenue_distributer_id = #{distributerId} AND gb_ai_daily_revenue_record_date >= #{startDate} AND gb_ai_daily_revenue_record_date <= #{endDate}
